title: Analyst- IT Compliance
description:
Dover is a diversified global manufacturer with annual revenue of $8 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, specialty systems, consumable supplies, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments: Engineered Products, Clean Energy & Fueling, Imaging & Identification, Pumps & Process Solutions and Climate & Sustainable Technologies. Dover combines global scale with operational agility to lead the markets we serve. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 60 years, our team of approximately 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible. Headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, Dover trades on the New York Stock Exchange under "DOV." Additional information is available at dovercorporation.com.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Control & Evidence Management. Execute assigned IT compliance control activities in accordance with established methodologies and timelines. Maintain accurate control records, including test procedures, results, and evidence. Prepare clear, complete workpapers supporting conclusions, exceptions, and recommendations. Ensure traceability between controls, systems, applications, and compliance requirements. Proactively engage leadership to clarify exceptions and improve control quality. Compliance Monitoring & Issue Management, Identify control exceptions and evaluate them using defined criteria, including root cause analysis. Log and track control deficiencies and remediation actions through closure. Monitor remediation progress and follow up with control owners. Validate remediation evidence prior to issue closure. Audit & Review Support, Support audit readiness by ensuring documentation is current, complete, and aligned with expectations. Respond to audit inquiries and assist with evidence collection and clarification. Reporting & Data Quality • Support preparation of compliance reports and dashboards by ensuring data accuracy and completeness. Assist with testing GRC workflow updates related to usability, process effectiveness, and data integrity.
* 2+ years of experience working within a large audit (Big 4) or professional services company. Experience supporting IT audit, IT compliance, technology risk, or related operational roles. Direct exposure to internal or external audit processes. Bachelor’s degree in information systems, cyber security, or related field or equivalent experience. Familiarity with industry frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls). Understanding of common IT control domains (e.g, access management, change management, IT operations, etc.). • Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail and organizational discipline. • Ability to follow structured documents and maintain audit-ready documentation. Experience with GRC platforms or similar compliance tracking tools preferred.
Strong execution discipline, clear documentation skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with control owners, business stakeholders, and auditors to ensure consistent / audit-ready compliance outcomes.  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

  

Fraudulent Recruiting Disclaimer: Dover Corporation and our affiliated operating companies want to alert applicants to internet job posting fraud, where parties posing as Dover employees, recruiters, or other agents, try to engage with online candidates in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. We do not endorse or engage in any recruitment practices that involve payment or personal information outside of our official application and hiring process. Please verify the authenticity of an invitation to apply for a job, or for a job offer by contacting us directly through our Dover and affiliated operating company websites at https://careers.dovercorporation.com/ . To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice on our careers site.

title: Senior Staff Engineer (Product Engineer-Legal Applications)
description:
**Company Description**

**We're Nagarro.**

We are a Digital Product Engineering company that is scaling in a big way! We build products, services, and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. We work at a scale — across all devices and digital mediums, and our people exist everywhere in the world (18500+ experts across 39 countries, to be exact). Our work culture is dynamic and non-hierarchical. We are looking for great new colleagues. That is where you come in!

 **Job Description**

**Requirements**

* Experience : 7.5+ years
* Relevant experience in product engineering, application administration, application support, or enterprise application operations.
* Strong hands-on experience managing and supporting enterprise legal applications.
* Mandatory experience with at least 2–3 legal applications, such as iManage, App4Legal, Nasdaq Boardvantage, Englo be Access Admin, or Moody Orbis.
* Strong knowledge of legal application administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Experience managing application upgrades, patching, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Hands-on experience with Disaster Recovery (DR), failover execution, recovery procedures, and business continuity planning.
* Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS and/or Azure.
* Strong experience supporting and executing on-premises to cloud migration initiatives.
* Experience with SQL database administration, database troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Good understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, firewalls, SSL/TLS, VPNs, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python scripting for automation and operational support.
* Strong understanding of application security, access management, data protection, and compliance requirements.
* Experience monitoring application performance and resolving complex production issues.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and recovery procedures.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with infrastructure, security, database, application, and business teams.
* Experience with ITSM tools and incident, problem, and change management processes is desirable.
* Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes is an advantage.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC 2 is desirable.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation is an advantage.
* Strong ownership and ability to manage critical applications in enterprise environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage, administer, and support enterprise legal applications, ensuring system availability, reliability, and optimal performance.
* Provide production support, investigate incidents, manage escalations, and resolve application-related issues within agreed service levels.
* Execute Disaster Recovery (DR) failovers, recovery procedures, and business continuity activities to ensure operational resilience.
* Manage application upgrades, patching, maintenance, enhancements, and release activities.
* Lead and support on-premises to cloud migration initiatives across AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Plan and execute application migration activities, including environment assessment, dependency mapping, migration planning, testing, cutover, and post-migration validation.
* Ensure application security, regulatory compliance, access management, and adherence to enterprise IT policies.
* Monitor application health, system availability, logs, and performance metrics to proactively identify and resolve potential issues.
* Perform SQL database administration activities, including database monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure and connectivity issues involving DNS, firewalls, SSL/TLS certificates, VPNs, and network configurations.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python to streamline administration and operational activities.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, support guides, recovery procedures, and operational runbooks.
* Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, cloud engineers, database administrators, security teams, and external vendors.
* Support application testing, deployment, configuration management, and production readiness activities.
* Ensure legal applications meet availability, performance, security, and business continuity requirements.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance application stability, operational efficiency, and service quality.

  
**Qualifications**

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: IT Compliance & Controls Analyst II
description:
**Description**

The IT Compliance/Controls Analyst II is a pivotal role within the Global Information Security (GIS) department, dedicated to advancing IT governance and managing organizational risk. This position ensures the robust implementation and operational effectiveness of critical IT controls. A primary focus is maintaining rigorous compliance with key global regulatory and assurance obligations, including but not limited to CFTC, SEC, Fedline Assurance, and SWIFT CSP, for independent effective challenge and minimize corporate risk. The incumbent will conduct comprehensive security risk assessments, with a specialized emphasis on evaluating AI/ML deployments and frontier model concepts. Furthermore, the role involves driving automated AI-based risk and compliance initiatives to keep the organization at the forefront of technological and process evolution.

**Primary Accountabilities**

* Internalize and contribute to the strategic goals of the CME Group Technology Compliance Team.
* Maintain expert knowledge of the company’s IT infrastructure, applications, and governance standards.
* Execute control assessments to verify the adequacy of internal controls and adherence to corporate policies.
* Conduct comprehensive security risk assessments to preemptively address audit findings and reduce risk.
* Evaluate security risks associated with AI/ML deployments and emerging frontier model technologies.
* Lead forward-looking AI-driven risk initiatives to ensure continuous alignment with regulatory advancements.
* Design and implement Python-based control automation pipelines, integrating with enterprise APIs (Archer GRC, CyberArk, AD, HashiCorp Vault) for programmatic evidence validation.
* Ensure strict compliance with regulatory obligations, including CFTC, Fedline, and SWIFT CSP frameworks.
* Produce detailed, logical work-papers documenting testing procedures, results, and expert conclusions.
* Streamline control testing and risk processes utilizing automation and AI tools (e.g., Python, Gemini).
* Foster collaborative relationships with stakeholders to enhance the efficiency of the controls testing program.

**Key responsibilities include**

* Test internal technology controls in alignment with global regulatory requirements.
* Develop and recommend strategic remediation plans for identified control gaps.
* Identify opportunities for automation within IT control and risk assessment workflows.
* Provide regular status reporting and assist in the development of performance metrics for senior leadership.
* Partner with senior team members to advise management on strengthening controls and mitigating risks.
* Assess existing controls against evolving industry best practices and legal obligations.
* Execute standard lifecycle security risk assessments across diverse technical domains.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with emerging AI/ML technologies and frontier models.
* Support the establishment and refinement of compliance frameworks for AI applications.
* Maintain strict alignment with global regulatory standards in all remediation and testing activities.

  

The incumbent will collaborate with key partners such as IT Control Owners, Corporate Compliance, Business Process Owners and Global Assurance (i.e. Internal Audit) with supporting and establishing new approaches or changes in existing processes around documented requirements for mitigation of associated risks. Given the current control environment, precedents will need to be established to determine how to properly respond, leveraging defined controls but continuing to establish a policy reflecting a culture of compliance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related technical field.
* 2+ years of experience in IT audit, risk advisory, or information security within a financial or professional services firm.
* Professional certification highly desirable (CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or ISO 27001).

* Experience in technical aspects of IT Risk Management, Information Security, Technical Privacy, and/or IT Audits
* Working Knowledge in technologies and environments leveraging operational knowledge of Information Security best practices and industry standards to define the security controls and processes
* Experience as an Information Security analyst in a professional services firm or large enterprise, which includes interfacing with key control stakeholders, and participating in the planning and execution of projects in one or more of the following areas - Information Security, Risk Management, Technical Compliance, IT Security Audit, Remediation, and / or IT Risk Management (or) Experience in one or more Technology areas like Information Security, Software Development, IT Architecture, RPA, Data Analytics, etc. with a willingness to move to an IT audit role.
* Proficiency in Python-based automation for continuous control monitoring and data analysis.
* Ability to recommend and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of compliance controls.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (e.g., ISO 42001, EU AI Act) and best practices.
* Ability to participate in key team discussions and meetings; preparing concise, accurate documents and balancing project deadlines with the occurrence of unanticipated issues.
* Possess strong written and verbal communication skills/presentation skills, and ability to work with diverse teams
* Demonstrate thorough abilities as a team player; creating a positive environment while meeting project expectations and respecting the work-life quality of team members, providing candid, meaningful feedback in a timely manner, and keeping leadership informed of progress and issues.
* Interfacing with key stakeholders on control solutions. Participating in planning and execution of projects in: Information Security, Risk Management, Technical Privacy/Compliance, IT Security Audit, and / or IT Risk Management.
* Knowledge of industry frameworks such as NIST, COBIT, CFTC, and SOC2.
* Experience working with CAATs/data analytics tools and technologies such as Cloud, DevOps, Microservices, etc.
* Proficient usage of Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) & Audit tools

**CME Group: Where Futures are Made**

CME Group is the world’s leading derivatives marketplace. But who we are goes deeper than that. Here, you can impact markets worldwide. Transform industries. And build a career by shaping tomorrow. We invest in your success and you own it – all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. Problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. Those are our people. And we’re looking for more.

At CME Group, we embrace our employees' unique experiences and skills to ensure that everyone’s perspectives are acknowledged and valued. As an equal-opportunity employer, we consider all potential employees without regard to any protected characteristic.

**Important Notice:** Recruitment fraud is on the rise, with scammers using misleading promises of job offers and interviews to solicit money and personal information from job seekers. CME Group adheres to established procedures designed to maintain trust, confidence and security throughout our recruitment process.

title: Legal Entity Controller - Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Build your career in Financial Analysis while working in the world's most innovative bank which values creativity and excellence.


Job Summary:


As a Financial Analyst in our Finance team, you will spend each day defining, refining and delivering set goals for our firm.


﻿The Legal Entity Control team is responsible for financial oversight of their legal entity, and is tasked with ensuring that a strong control environment exists as it relates to all businesses, products, and operational areas that impact the Legal Entity financials and regulatory reporting of the firm.


This role provides an opportunity to interact with multiple lines of business and internal stakeholders while learning legal entity controllership end\-to\-end. The Analyst will liaise with the line of business finance teams, operations, and the Legal Entity Controller community to drive the Legal Entity agenda. Specific responsibilities will include:


Job responsibilities


* Legal entity accounting \& control, including month\-end close process, parent/child accounting, and equity pick\-up
* Monitor the monthly consolidation of income statement and balance sheet
* Month\-End analytical review of the legal entity to ensure completeness and accuracy of the financial statements and preparation of various reports, including contributions to the Monthly Controller's Book, as well as Legal Entity and Line of Business financial commentary
* Develop and maintain financial reports and schedules and perform various control procedures to ensure the integrity of reported financial results
* Investigate, analyze, and resolve issues, and support ad\-hoc requests for financial information received from across the firm
* Support Federal Reserve regulatory reporting
* Resolution \& Recovery – review and confirm periodic financial and non\-financial appendices
* General ledger balance reconciliation – Complete reconciliation of numerous general ledger accounts

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:


* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or related business field
* CPA/CA/ACCA/CIMA
* Proficient Excel skills
* Proficient organizational and problem\-solving skills
* Proficient verbal and written communication skills
* Comfortable liaising with business partners while building and maintaining relationships
* Ability to critically challenge with the goal of identifying control issues
* Show initiative; be able to work independently yet keep all parties apprised of key issues
* Ability to work on multiple priorities at the same time
* Ability to learn quickly and be comfortable to navigate various reporting systems/tools

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

J.P. Morgan Asset \& Wealth Management delivers industry\-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.  

  

Global Finance \& Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.
